text:
I've read every source file, the tests, the config, the build scripts, and the committed demo outputs. Here's the honest read.

## Overall assessment

The code quality itself is better than the framing of your request might suggest — clean module separation, consistent type hints, `yaml.safe_load`, no injection/pickle/security problems, sensible numerics, and a manifest that records provenance carefully. If everything ran, this would be close to approvable.

But it doesn't run. **The repo ships without its dataset and without any code to generate it.** `config.yaml:8` points at `data/stories`, `extract.py:26-27` hard-requires `data/stories/manifest.json` plus 80+ per-emotion story files, and that directory doesn't exist anywhere in the repo. There's also no story-generation script. So `make demo`, all three documented CLI commands, and `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` all die with `FileNotFoundError` out of the box. The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts (whose manifest embeds a `source_manifest` listing 20 topics) prove the data existed at some point on the author's machine and was simply never committed. That's the classic "works on the agent's machine" failure, and it's disqualifying for as-is approval.

Secondary theme worth knowing before you trust the demo: the tiny backend's steering response is hard-coded (`model.py:175-192` literally computes `valence × category_valence × strength`), so the tiny demo and `test_steering.py` validate the simulation, not the methodology. That's defensible for a CPU demo harness, but the README undersells how circular the tiny-mode "validation" is.

## Issues

| # | Location | Sev | Description |
|---|----------|-----|-------------|
| 1 | `extract.py:26-27`, `config.yaml:8` | High | Required `data/stories/` dataset is absent and no generator exists; demo, all CLI commands, and integration test fail with FileNotFoundError |
| 2 | `emovec/model.py:239-240` | Medium | If offsets are unavailable or `prompt.find()` misses, steering silently applies to **all** token positions instead of the activity tokens |
| 3 | `emovec/validate_contexts.py:66-67` | Medium | When "afraid" isn't in the emotion set, silently substitutes emotion index 0 but still writes files labeled `afraid_dosage` |
| 4 | `emovec/model.py:306-308` | Medium | Uses only the first sub-token of `" good"`/`" bad"` with no single-token check; fragile across tokenizers |
| 5 | `emovec/model.py:175-192`, `tests/test_steering.py`, `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:18` | Medium | Tiny backend hard-codes the steering effect and the diagonal>off-diagonal property; tests assert behavior baked into the simulation |
| 6 | `emovec/elo.py:19` | Low | Fixed temperature (÷20) is calibrated to the tiny backend's utility scale; real HF logit diffs (~1–5) collapse to p≈0.5 and near-zero Elo separation |
| 7 | `emovec/model.py:246` | Low | HF tokenization has no truncation/max-length guard; long stories can exceed model context |
| 8 | `emovec/extract.py:34-36` | Low | Duplicates the start-position logic inside `layer_position_mean` — two copies that can drift |
| 9 | `emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49` | Low | If fewer than 4 emotions qualify, the fallback silently discards all correlation-based picks for `emotions[:4]` |
| 10 | `config.yaml:10,50` | Low | Dead config keys: `neutral_corpus` and `min_reported_emotions` are never read by any code |
| 11 | `emovec/model.py:7` | Low | Unused import `Iterable` |
| 12 | `emovec/config.py:42-54` | Low | No config validation; a missing `scale`/`tiny` section yields `topics=0` and a confusing downstream `ValueError` |
| 13 | `emovec/vector_ops.py:31` | Low | Boundary bug: `threshold=0.0` returns 1 principal component instead of 0 |
| 14 | `outputs/tiny_demo/*` | Low | Generated artifacts committed into the repo; no `.gitignore` |

## Rewrite estimate

The codebase is ~1,000 lines of source plus ~100 of tests. The fixes above touch roughly 60–80 existing lines. The bigger cost is *missing* code: either committing the story dataset or writing the generation step (~100–150 new lines). Call it **~80 lines to change**, plus new data/generation work.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is** — not because the code is sloppy (it mostly isn't), but because the repo's every documented entry point is broken by the missing dataset, and the test suite that supposedly guards it can't pass either. Restore or generate `data/stories`, fix the silent-fallback issues (#2, #3, #9), and this becomes an approvable, reasonably well-built demo.
